observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation console standing upright on a black tufted surface, with a white DualSense controller in front of it.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a slightly different angle, with the same controller in front.
The console has a slim, vertical design with a PlayStation logo on the top left corner.
The controller is white with black accents and a touchpad in the center.
The background is a wooden slatted wall and a tiled floor.
Watermark 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' is visible on both photos.
No model number or serial number is visible on the console or controller in either photo.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage.

claims.evidence: The console is a PlayStation 5, but 'fat' is not visually confirmed in the photos. The 'UK used' claim cannot be verified from the images alone.
One DualSense controller is visible in both photos.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have battery issues
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label, or a video of the console's system settings screen showing the model number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified model, potentially lower value

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and functioning.
Close-up photo of the console's model and serial number label.
Video of the console's system settings screen showing the model number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
